::: {#sol-average-digit}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
averages = torch.stack(
    [images[labels == k].float().mean(dim=0) for k in range(10)]
)
print(averages.shape)
```

`labels == k` is a [tensor](#def-tensor) of `True` and `False`, one per image,
and indexing `images` with it keeps the images of digit `k`.
`.mean(dim=0)` averages over dimension 0, the images,
and leaves one average for each row and column.
`torch.stack` puts the ten 8 by 8 averages along a new first dimension.

:::
